verdict.rationale: Bugbot's docs say it reads existing top-level and inline PR comments to avoid duplicate suggestions and build on prior feedback, so a rejection reply within a PR can inform later reviews of that PR. Teams can also hand-write `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` or organization-wide rules to suppress unwanted feedback patterns. There is no evidence of automatic learning from pushback across PRs, and one hands-on report describes the reviewer (Bugbot or Claude) flip-flopping and asking to revert fixes it had recommended. Missing for 10: automatic learning from dismissed or rejected comments that persists across PRs, evidence that rejected feedback is reliably not repeated, independent corroboration of the in-PR comment-context behavior.
